title: Super Palindromes
key_insight: 枚举所有可能的回文数根（其平方也是回文数），根的范围在sqrt(L)到sqrt(R)之间
approach:
1. 枚举回文数的前半部分
2. 构造完整回文数（奇数位和偶数位长度）
3. 计算其平方
4. 检查平方是否也是回文且在范围内
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def superpalindromesInRange(self, left: str, right: str) -> int:
        L, R = int(left), int(right)
        def is_pali(x):
            s = str(x)
            return s == s[::-1]
        ans = 0
        # odd length palindromes
        for k in range(1, 100000):
            s = str(k)
            pal = int(s + s[-2::-1])
            sq = pal * pal
            if sq > R: break
            if sq >= L and is_pali(sq): ans += 1
        # even length palindromes
        for k in range(1, 100000):
            s = str(k)
            pal = int(s + s[::-1])
            sq = pal * pal
            if sq > R: break
            if sq >= L and is_pali(sq): ans += 1
        return ans

title: Snakes and Ladders

approach:

2. 从位置1开始BFS
3. 每次可以走1-6步
4. 遇到梯子/蛇则跳转到目标位置
5. 返回到达n*n的最少步数
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def snakesAndLadders(self, board) -> int:
        from collections import deque
        n = len(board)
        def get_pos(s):
            r, c = divmod(s - 1, n)
            if r % 2 == 1: c = n - 1 - c
            return n - 1 - r, c
        visited = set()
        q = deque([(1, 0)])
        visited.add(1)
        while q:
            curr, dist = q.popleft()
            for i in range(1, 7):
                nxt = curr + i
                if nxt > n * n: break
                r, c = get_pos(nxt)
                if board[r][c] != -1:
                    nxt = board[r][c]
                if nxt == n * n: return dist + 1
                if nxt not in visited:
                    visited.add(nxt)
                    q.append((nxt, dist + 1))
        return -1

class Solution:
    def hasGroupsSizeX(self, deck) -> bool:
        from math import gcd
        from collections import Counter
        from functools import reduce
        cnt = Counter(deck)
        return reduce(gcd, cnt.values()) >= 2

4. 返回max(max_sum, total-min_sum)，注意全负数情况
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maxSubarraySumCircular(self, nums) -> int:
        total = 0
        max_sum = cur_max = nums[0]
        min_sum = cur_min = nums[0]
        total = nums[0]
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            total += nums[i]
            cur_max = max(nums[i], cur_max + nums[i])
            max_sum = max(max_sum, cur_max)
            cur_min = min(nums[i], cur_min + nums[i])
            min_sum = min(min_sum, cur_min)
        if max_sum < 0: return max_sum
        return max(max_sum, total - min_sum)

title: Three Equal Parts
key_insight: 三部分二进制值相等意味着1的个数必须被3整除，且末尾0的个数决定分割位置
approach:
1. 统计1的总数，必须是3的倍数
2. 找到每段1的起始位置
3. 用末尾0对齐三段
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def threeEqualParts(self, arr):
        ones = sum(arr)
        if ones == 0: return [0, 2]
        if ones % 3: return [-1, -1]
        k = ones // 3
        # find starts of each third
        idx = [i for i, v in enumerate(arr) if v]
        s1, s2, s3 = idx[0], idx[k], idx[2*k]
        n = len(arr)
        tail = n - s3  # length of last part
        if s2 + tail > s3 or s1 + tail > s2: return [-1, -1]
        if arr[s1:s1+tail] != arr[s2:s2+tail] or arr[s1:s1+tail] != arr[s3:s3+tail]:
            return [-1, -1]
        return [s1+tail-1, s2+tail]

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def validMountainArray(self, arr):
        n = len(arr)
        if n < 3: return False
        i, j = 0, n-1
        while i < n-1 and arr[i] < arr[i+1]: i += 1
        while j > 0 and arr[j] < arr[j-1]: j -= 1
        return i == j and i != 0 and j != n-1

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def flipEquiv(self, root1, root2):
        if not root1 and not root2: return True
        if not root1 or not root2: return False
        if root1.val != root2.val: return False
        return (self.flipEquiv(root1.left, root2.left) and self.flipEquiv(root1.right, root2.right)) or \
               (self.flipEquiv(root1.left, root2.right) and self.flipEquiv(root1.right, root2.left))

key_insight: 按绝对值排序后贪心匹配：每个数尝试与其两倍配对
approach:
1. 按绝对值排序
2. 用计数器记录每个数剩余次数
3. 遍历时贪心匹配2*x

title: Delete Columns to Make Sorted II
key_insight: 贪心保留能维持排序的列，记录已确定严格有序的行对
approach:
1. 逐列检查
2. 若该列不破坏已有排序则保留
3. 记录哪些相邻行已确定严格有序

title: Tallest Billboard
key_insight: dp[diff]表示两组差值为diff时较大组的最大高度
approach:
1. dp[diff]=较大组高度
2. 每根钢管可放左组、右组或不用
3. 答案为dp[0]

title: Prison Cells After N Days
key_insight: 状态有限必有循环，找到循环周期后取模
approach:
1. 模拟状态变化找循环
2. 记录每个状态首次出现的天数
3. 找到循环后用余数确定最终状态

title: Check Completeness of a Binary Tree
key_insight: BFS遍历中遇到空节点后不应再遇到非空节点
approach:
1. BFS层次遍历
2. 遇到第一个None标记end
3. 之后再遇到非None则不完全

title: Regions Cut By Slashes
key_insight: 将每个格子细分为4个三角形区域，用并查集合并相邻区域
approach:
1. 每个格子分为上下左右4个三角形
2. 空格合并4个三角形
3. /和\分别合并对应三角形，相邻格子合并边界三角形

title: Delete Columns to Make Sorted III
key_insight: 类似LIS，找最长的列子序列使得保留这些列后每行非递减
approach:
1. dp[j]表示以第j列结尾的最长合法列子序列
2. 列j可接在列i后面当且仅当所有行中该列>=前列
3. 答案=总列数-max(dp)
